title: Scheduled Large-Item Delivery Late-Change Fee: Computation
content:
**Northgate Store and Online Orders — late-change fee on a reschedule of a Scheduled Large-Item Delivery appointment.**

**1. Free reschedule.** A reschedule requested two or more calendar days ahead of the scheduled date while the customer's confirmed reschedule requests already on the order are fewer than the program's free reschedules is a free reschedule and carries no late-change fee; every other reschedule carries the late-change fee. The customer's confirmed reschedule requests already on the order, the request being made not counted, are the confirmed reschedule requests recorded on the order before this request.

**2. Counting days.** Every count of calendar days leaves out the day it starts from and includes the day it ends on. The days ahead of a reschedule are counted from the day of the request to the scheduled date.

**3. Amount.** The standard late-change notice charge is the program's late cancellation fee, and the standard late-change fee is that notice charge, rounded half up to the cent. The late-change fee is the total of the late-change notice charge and every other late-change charge and surcharge on the reschedule, less every late-change courtesy reduction on it; the total is rounded half up to the cent and is never below zero.

**Free-reschedule test (hypothetical program allowing 2 free reschedules).**

| Days ahead of the scheduled date | Confirmed customer reschedule requests already on the order | Free reschedule |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 1 | yes |
| 2 | 1 | yes, two days ahead suffices |
| 1 | 0 | no, fewer than two days ahead |
| 6 | 2 | no, the requests are not fewer than the free reschedules |

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** Were a program's late cancellation fee 70.00, a reschedule requested one day ahead of the scheduled date would carry a late-change notice charge of 70.00 and a late-change fee of 70.00.
